summary: kiln-pool pods are shared mutable state — once leased, any pre-existing scripts on the pod (other lab bootstraps, autonomous loops) can also acquire/restart kiln serve, causing mid-eval HTTP 500 / RemoteDisconnected for the new lessee. On this pod, the pi-compaction-grpo v062 autonomous loop's startup script restarted kiln serve mid-iter0-eval and 4/23 tasks errored. There's no isolation mechanism between concurrent agents sharing a pod's filesystem + kiln-serve singleton.
repro_hint: Acquire any kiln-pool H100; ps -ef | grep -i pi-compaction may reveal another lab's bootstrap script still running. The kiln-serve binary itself is a singleton on port 8420 — only one process can bind it.
